# sigstore-conformance tests expected to fail (strict xfail: an unexpected
# pass fails CI, so remove entries as features land). Shell-style patterns
# matched against pytest test names. Used by .github/workflows/conformance.yml
# and scripts/run-conformance.sh.

test_verify*-rekor2-checkpoint-origin-not-first]
test_verify*-rekor2-checkpoint-two-sigs-cosigned]
test_verify*-rekor2-checkpoint-two-sigs-from-origin]
test_verify*-bundle-with-sct-with-extensions]
